title: Table 2: 9 vertices, edges 0-4 0-5 1-5 2-6 3-6 0-7 2-7 4-7 1-8 3-8 4-8 6-8: its edge function needs at least 16 AND/OR/NOT gates of fan-in at most two
statement: ∀ t : ℕ, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize 9 (fun x : Fin 9 → Bool => (x 0 && x 4) || (x 0 && x 5) || (x 1 && x 5) || (x 2 && x 6) || (x 3 && x 6) || (x 0 && x 7) || (x 2 && x 7) || (x 4 && x 7) || (x 1 && x 8) || (x 3 && x 8) || (x 4 && x 8) || (x 6 && x 8)) t → 16 ≤ t
unlocks: One exact entry of Table 2: whether NOT gates save a gate on this nine-vertex graph's edge function, against the AND/OR star circuit.
sketch: Known: an AND/OR circuit of exactly k gates (edges plus cover number minus one) computes this edge function, so k is an upper bound. Our gate-elimination recursion on checked rows (an input fixed costs a gate, the 3-or-4 two-branch step, a fresh input costs one, the small-graph rows and 29 checked eight-vertex rows) reaches k - 1, no further. The bound needs one more gate; its twin needs a circuit with NOT gates of k - 1 gates; no NOT saving on a graph is in our tables. Truth unknown. Size: large; such eight-vertex rows (11 to 13 gates) were checked from outside proofs in about an hour each.
